card.name: Linking words before a drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, following, receiving, received or the, right before a brand-name drug in trial results. Typical phrases are 'patients treated with' and 'during treatment with'.

modes.label: treated with + drug
modes.description: The word 'with' after treated or treatment, just before the drug name.
modes.example: 7 mm Hg in patients treated<< with>> ZEPOSIA and 2.

modes.label: Other linking verbs
modes.description: Following, receiving or received just before the drug name.
modes.example: 50203, 272 patients with RAS- mutant mCRC tumors<< received>> Vectibix in combination with FOL

modes.label: Arm naming
modes.description: The word 'the' before a drug name when comparing regimens.
modes.example: 16% in the placebo regimen) and Grade 2 (11% in<< the>> NINLARO regimen and
